pages.text_sw:
Dira
“Kuwa Taasisi ya Mfano nchini kwa kutoa huduma bora katika kushauri masuala ya kiuchumi na kijamii kwa wadau wake wote”.
Dhima
“Kuimarisha mifumo ya Serikali za mitaa na kuratibu huduma maendeleo ya Jamii na za kiuchumi kwa wadau wetu kwa kutoa ushauri, huduma za kitaalam na kuelekeza mambo ya kisheria kwa wananchi wote wa mkoa wa Manyara”.

pages.title: Administration and Human Resource Management
pages.text_en:
ACTIVITIES
i. Interpret public service Regulations, standing orders and other related registration.
ii. Oversee the implementation of ethics and values promotion activities including corruption prevention education.
iii. Administer Human Resource Planning.
iv. Administer and oversee implementation of activities such as recruitment, selection, orientation, training and employee development, promotion, discipline, retention, motivation, performance management and general staff welfare in RS.
v. Provide advice on management of human resource in LGA’s.
vi. Ensure optimal, efficient and effective management and utilization of human resource.
vii. Coordinate workers Council and Trade Union affairs.
viii. Oversee the development and implementation of effective policies, procedures and guidelines for recruitment, training, development, deployment, retention of staff, promotions, performance management in RS.
ix. Conduct regular human resource audit and staff inventory in RS.
x. Process and update leave records such as vacation, sick, maternity, study and terminal.
xi. Coordinate complains and grievances handling.
xii. Provide registry, messengerial and courier services, and manage office records.
xiii. Handle protocol matters.
xiv. Manage public Employee Performance Management Information systems (PEPMIS).
xv. Facilitate provision of security services, transport and general utilities.
xvi. Facilitate maintenance of office equipment, buildings and grounds.
xvii. Coordinate implementation of ethics and value promotion activities.
xviii. Coordinate implementation of diversity issues.
xix. Provide advice on organizational efficiency of the office, and
xx. Advice on implementation of employment, labor laws and related legislations.
pages.text_sw:
MAJUKUMU
i. Kutafsiri Kanuni za utumishi wa umma, amri za kudumu na usajili mwingine unaohusiana.
ii. Kusimamia utekelezaji wa shughuli za kukuza maadili na maadili ikiwa ni pamoja na elimu ya kuzuia rushwa.
iii. Kusimamia Mipango ya Rasilimali Watu.
iv. Simamia na usimamie utekelezaji wa shughuli kama vile kuajiri, uteuzi, mwelekeo, mafunzo na ukuzaji wa wafanyikazi, kukuza, nidhamu, kudumisha, motisha, usimamizi wa utendakazi na ustawi wa jumla wa wafanyikazi katika RS.
v. Kutoa ushauri juu ya usimamizi wa rasilimali watu katika Halmashauri.
vi. Kuhakikisha usimamizi bora, ufanisi na matumizi ya rasilimali watu.
vii. Kuratibu masuala ya Baraza la Wafanyakazi na Vyama vya Wafanyakazi.
viii. Kusimamia uundaji na utekelezaji wa sera madhubuti, taratibu na miongozo ya kuajiri, mafunzo, maendeleo, uwekaji kazi, uhifadhi wa wafanyikazi, upandishaji vyeo, ​​usimamizi wa utendaji katika RS.
ix. Kufanya ukaguzi wa mara kwa mara wa rasilimali watu na hesabu ya wafanyikazi katika RS.
x. Mchakato na usasishe rekodi za likizo kama vile likizo, wagonjwa, uzazi, masomo na wastaafu.
xi. Kuratibu malalamiko na kushughulikia malalamiko.
xii. Toa sajili, huduma za messenger na courier, na udhibiti rekodi za ofisi.
xiii. Shughulikia mambo ya itifaki.
xiv. Kusimamia mifumo ya Taarifa za Usimamizi wa Utendaji wa Wafanyakazi wa umma (PEPMIS).
xv. Kuwezesha utoaji wa huduma za usalama, usafiri na huduma za jumla.
xvi. Kuwezesha matengenezo ya vifaa vya ofisi, majengo na viwanja.
xvii. Kuratibu utekelezaji wa shughuli za maadili na kukuza thamani.
xviii. Kuratibu utekelezaji wa masuala mbalimbali.
xix. Kutoa ushauri juu ya ufanisi wa shirika wa ofisi, na
xx. Ushauri wa utekelezaji wa sheria za ajira, sheria za kazi na sheria zinazohusiana.

pages.title: Planning and Coordination
pages.text_en:
PLANNING AND COORDINATION SECTION.
ACTIVITIES
i. Conceptualize and interpret National and sectoral policies and strategies into Regional context and advice accordingly.
ii. Coordinate preparation and implementation of strategic and action plans for RS.
iii. Scrutinize, consolidate LGAs plan and Budgets and coordinate preparation of Regional plans and budget for RAS.
iv. Coordinate research activities in the Region.
v. Serve as a secretariat to Regional consultative committees.
vi. Coordinate overall performance of public and private sector institutions in the Region.
vii. Coordinate population and other census exercises.
viii. Assist and advise LGAs on project identification, preparation and implementation.
ix. Coordinate Regional disaster management.
x. Assist LGAs budget preparations and expenditure, and
xi. Oversee the implementation of the Election manifesto in the Region.
pages.text_sw:
SEHEMU YA MIPANGO NA URATIBU.
SHUGHULI
i. Kuweka dhana na kutafsiri sera na mikakati ya Kitaifa na kisekta katika muktadha wa Kikanda na ushauri ipasavyo.
ii. Kuratibu maandalizi na utekelezaji wa mipango mkakati na utekelezaji wa RS.
iii. Kuchambua, kuunganisha mpango na Bajeti za Mamlaka za Serikali za Mitaa na kuratibu utayarishaji wa mipango ya Mikoa na bajeti ya RAS.
iv. Kuratibu shughuli za utafiti katika Mkoa.
v. Kutumikia kama sekretarieti ya kamati za ushauri za Mikoa.
vi. Kuratibu utendaji wa jumla wa taasisi za umma na sekta binafsi katika Mkoa.
vii. Kuratibu idadi ya watu na mazoezi mengine ya sensa.
viii. Kusaidia na kushauri Halmashauri kuhusu utambuzi, maandalizi na utekelezaji wa mradi.
ix. Kuratibu usimamizi wa maafa wa Mkoa.
x. Kusaidia matayarisho ya bajeti na matumizi ya Halmashauri, na
xi. Kusimamia utekelezaji wa Ilani ya Uchaguzi katika Mkoa.

Community Development Unit
pages.text_en:
COMMUNITY DEVELOMENT UNIT.
ACTIVITIES
i. Analyse, interpret and supervise implementation of policies, strategies, laws, guidelines and international conversions related to good governance, community development, gender and special needs groups, children parenting and family development in the Region.
ii. Facilitate community participation (self – help efforts and volunteerism) in planning, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of their projects in solving their social and economic challenges at LGA level.
iii. Provide technical support to LGAs on opportunities and obstacles to Development (O & OD) planning approach.
iv. Track and evaluate Women, Youths and people with disability facilitation fund.,
v. Promote community sensitization programs on patriotism, volunteerism and self – help spirit to bring social and economic local and national development in LGAs.
vi. Coordinate and ensure sound projects from the group of Women, Youths and people with Disabilities.
vii. Coordinate implementation of diversities including gender, disability, HIV/AIDS at Regional level.
viii. Facilitate and coordinate operations of economic empowerment programs/projects in LGAs.
ix. Coordinate and monitor civil society Organizations ((NGOs, FBOs, CBOs) programs/projects implementation at community in the Region, and
x. Promote and facilitate public private partnership initiatives in implementing programs/projects to meet community needs at LGAs.
pages.text_sw:
KITENGO CHA MAENDELEO YA JAMII.
SHUGHULI
i. Kuchambua, kutafsiri na kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, mikakati, sheria, miongozo na mabadiliko ya kimataifa yanayohusu utawala bora, maendeleo ya jamii, jinsia na makundi yenye mahitaji maalum, malezi ya watoto na maendeleo ya familia katika Mkoa.
ii. Kuwezesha ushiriki wa jamii (jitihada za kujisaidia na kujitolea) katika kupanga, kutekeleza, kufuatilia na kutathmini miradi yao katika kutatua changamoto zao za kijamii na kiuchumi katika ngazi ya Halmashauri.
iii. Kutoa usaidizi wa kiufundi kwa Mamlaka za Serikali za Mitaa kuhusu fursa na vikwazo kwa mbinu ya upangaji wa Maendeleo (O & OD).
iv. Fuatilia na kutathmini mfuko wa kuwezesha Wanawake, Vijana na watu wenye ulemavu.,
v. Kukuza programu za uhamasishaji wa jamii juu ya uzalendo, kujitolea na moyo wa kujisaidia ili kuleta maendeleo ya kijamii na kiuchumi ndani na kitaifa katika Halmashauri.
vi. Kuratibu na kuhakikisha miradi mizuri kutoka kwa kikundi cha Wanawake, Vijana na watu wenye Ulemavu.
vii. Kuratibu utekelezaji wa masuala mbalimbali yakiwemo jinsia, ulemavu, VVU/UKIMWI katika ngazi ya Mkoa.
viii. Kuwezesha na kuratibu uendeshaji wa programu/miradi ya uwezeshaji wananchi kiuchumi katika Halmashauri.
ix. Kuratibu na kufuatilia Asasi za kiraia ((NGOs, FBOs, CBOs) programu/miradi ya utekelezaji katika jamii katika Mkoa, na
x. Kukuza na kuwezesha mipango ya ubia kati ya sekta ya umma na sekta binafsi katika kutekeleza programu/miradi ili kukidhi mahitaji ya jamii katika Halmashauri.
